3. Translate emotion into material: stutter, spikes and eyes become walls, thorns and light.
4. Test the body at every scale: sit, stand, lie and crawl, so visitors can feel what the women feel.

zh-Hant.heading: 我如何教這套方法
zh-Hant.body:
1. 從令人心痛的數據出發：統計數字界定了空間為誰而做。
2. 以故事作為結構：影集的四段情節化為四個相連的空間。
3. 把情緒轉譯為材料：結巴、尖刺與眼睛化為牆、荊棘與光。
4. 在每種尺度測試身體：坐、站、躺、爬，讓參觀者感受女性的感受。

pins.title: Eco-Friendly Brand — Dressing an Old Building in Recycled Paper
pins.description:
An experimental eco-friendly brand store in an old Dongshankou building, lined with handmade paper of bark, bamboo powder and pulp, where old clothes are exchanged and recycled.

Dongshankou, Guangzhou, China | Individual work / material experimentation, eco-friendly brand store | Student Project | Design Director: Yu Chun Tsai (full-cycle supervision)

zh-Hant.title: 環保品牌——為老建築穿上再生紙
zh-Hant.description:
在東山口的一棟老建築中，設計一間實驗性的環保品牌店：以樹皮、竹粉與紙漿手工製成的紙覆蓋室內，讓舊衣在此交換與回收。

中國廣州東山口｜個人作品／材料實驗、環保品牌店｜學生作品｜設計總監 Yu Chun Tsai，全程指導

captions: Handmade model of the store: three floors lined with the recycled paper material, lit from inside.
店鋪的手工模型：三層樓的內壁覆滿再生紙材料，從室內打光。

sections.heading: Problem
sections.body: Garments are replaced and thrown away at a high rate: more than 97 % of clothing comes from virgin feedstock, less than 1 % is recycled in a closed loop, and as much as 73 % of the material is landfilled or incinerated after use. The Fendi and Kengo Kuma co-branding showed that natural materials such as tree bark, bamboo powder and paper pulp can replace them, so the project sets out to make its own.
captions: Value delivered — educational, economic, brand, environmental and social value around the eco-brand.

zh-Hant.heading: 問題
zh-Hant.body: 服裝的汰換與丟棄率極高：超過 97% 的服裝來自原生原料，閉環回收不到 1%，多達 73% 的材料在使用後被掩埋或焚化。Fendi 與隈研吾的聯名顯示，樹皮、竹粉與紙漿等天然材料可以取而代之，因此本案著手製作自己的材料。
captions: 價值傳遞——圍繞環保品牌的教育、經濟、品牌、環境與社會價值。

sections.heading: Research
sections.body: Bark was pulled apart into fibres, made into pulp, filtered evenly through a handmade mesh frame and pressed dry, with colours and ingredients added for different effects. Twelve mixes of tree bark, bamboo powder, petals and paper pulp were compared for weight, strength, waterproofing and hardness.
captions: A finished installation from the course experiments, and different attempts — colours and ingredients added to the original pulp.
Experimental concept — twelve mixes of tree bark, bamboo powder, petals and paper pulp, rated for weight, strength, waterproofing and hardness.

zh-Hant.heading: 研究
zh-Hant.body: 把樹皮撕成纖維、製成紙漿，以自製網框均勻過濾後壓乾，並加入不同顏色與成分，創造不同效果。比較十二種樹皮、竹粉、花瓣與紙漿的配比，測試重量、強度、防水性與硬度。
captions: 課程實驗的完成裝置，以及不同的嘗試——在原始紙漿中加入各種顏色與成分。
實驗概念——十二種樹皮、竹粉、花瓣與紙漿的配比，評比重量、強度、防水性與硬度。

sections.heading: Development
sections.body: Bark-based mix 5 proved strong enough for a wall carrying a little weight, woven mix 8 can be a screen or a divider, striped mix 4 can be furnishings, decorations and curtains, and the remaining blocks become non-load-bearing decorative walls. An old building in Dongshankou is renovated in two designs: changing a teahouse, studio and dwelling into a gallery, store and studio with dwelling, and dressing the building in the new material.
captions: Experimental hypothesis, before and after renovation, and the original architectural hand model.
Axonometric diagram — non-public stairs, public stairs and the public entrance.
Handmade model interiors, and the ground floor: exhibition area, cashier's desk, restrooms, small balcony and garden.

zh-Hant.heading: 推演
zh-Hant.body: 以樹皮為主的配比 5 證實足以作為承受少量重量的牆；編織的配比 8 可作為屏風或空間隔斷；條狀的配比 4 可作為家具、裝飾與窗簾；其餘的塊材則做成非承重的裝飾牆。東山口的一棟老建築以兩種設計改造：把茶館、工作室與住所改為畫廊、店鋪與工作室兼住所，並以新材料為建築「穿上外衣」。
captions: 實驗假設、改造前後，以及原始建築手工模型。
軸測圖——非公共樓梯、公共樓梯與公共入口。
手工模型的室內，以及一樓：展覽區、收銀台、洗手間、小陽台與花園。

sections.heading: Outcome
sections.body: On the second floor people can bring in their old clothes and exchange them for new ones, or make up the difference in price, and a craft area shows how the materials are made and recycled; the third-floor office has a machine that recycles old clothes. Plants grown in recycled residues, soil and water are reused in clothing and building materials, and the façade material yellows with the seasons and is replaced from time to time.
captions: Environmental function analysis — the second floor (store, craft area, fitting room, small and large balconies), the recycling cycle and the clothes-hanger.
Building and plant analysis — section and façade of the dressed building.
Circulatory system, façade wall structure and lighting nodes — the material changes from spring to winter.

zh-Hant.heading: 成果
zh-Hant.body: 在二樓，人們可以帶舊衣來換新衣，或補差價；工藝區展示材料如何製作與回收；三樓辦公室設有回收舊衣的機器。以回收殘料、土壤與水栽種的植物，會再被用於服裝與建築材料；立面材料隨季節泛黃，並不時更換。
captions: 環境機能分析——二樓（店鋪、工藝區、試衣間、小陽台與大陽台）、回收循環與衣架。
建築與植栽分析——穿上外衣的建築剖面與立面。
循環系統、立面牆體構造與照明節點——材料從春天到冬天的變化。

sections.heading: How I Teach This Method
sections.body:
1. Start from a waste stream: the numbers on discarded garments set the brief.
2. Make the material yourself: pulp, filter, press and dry before you design with it.
3. Test and compare: twelve mixes, four properties, then a job for each result.
4. Let the building show the cycle: exchange, craft and recycling become the plan.

zh-Hant.heading: 我如何教這套方法
zh-Hant.body:
1. 從一條廢棄物流出發：被丟棄衣物的數據就是設計任務。
2. 親手製作材料：先製漿、過濾、壓製與晾乾，再用它來設計。
3. 測試與比較：十二種配比、四項性能，再為每個結果找到用途。
4. 讓建築展現循環：交換、工藝與回收成為平面。

pins.title: Art Museum House — A Gallery to Live In
pins.description:
An art gallery with a residential function, designed for oneself: curved floors let visitors see the exhibitions while the owner paints, unseen, in private.

Individual work / art museum house, residential gallery | Student Project | Design Director: Yu Chun Tsai (full-cycle supervision)

zh-Hant.title: 美術館住宅——可以居住的畫廊
zh-Hant.description:
一座為自己設計、兼具居住機能的美術館：弧形的樓層讓參觀者看展，而主人在私密之中、不被看見地作畫。

個人作品／美術館住宅、居住式畫廊｜學生作品｜設計總監 Yu Chun Tsai，全程指導

captions: Aerial view of the house: curved walls of different materials and light divide functions, with clear and blurred boundaries between private and public.
住宅鳥瞰：以不同材料與光線的弧形牆劃分機能，私密與公共之間的邊界時而清晰、時而模糊。

sections.heading: Problem
sections.body: The project is based on personal experience: nature and painting have been a solace and a cure for many emotions, and the student still loves painting after studying design. So the brief is an art museum house for oneself, which explores the public and private nature of space: people can be invited to see the exhibitions while the owner creates, without being disturbed in private life.
captions: Some personal creations — paintings of birds: the eyes represent voyeurs, and birds without feet, unable to stop, need an isolated resting place.
My reflections and function bubble chart — public space plus separate space equals mixed space, with the bedroom, garden, restroom, office and lounge.

zh-Hant.heading: 問題
zh-Hant.body: 本案源自個人經驗：大自然與繪畫一直是慰藉，也治癒了許多情緒；即使學了設計，學生依然熱愛繪畫。因此設計任務是一座為自己而做的美術館住宅，探討空間的公共與私密性：可以邀請人們來看展，而主人在創作時，私人生活不受打擾。
captions: 個人創作——以鳥為題的畫作：眼睛代表窺視者；沒有腳、無法停歇的鳥，需要一個隔絕的棲息之所。
我的反思與機能泡泡圖——公共空間加上獨立空間，等於混合空間，包含臥室、花園、洗手間、辦公室與起居室。

sections.heading: Research
sections.body: An inhabitable gallery would need a completely staggered internal movement, so the owner does not meet exhibition-goers while resting and creating. The case study compares Adolf Loos's Raumplan, a room-like space with a cultivated inner vision, with Le Corbusier's Plan Libre, a mobile space and free plan with a vast vision, and models both.
captions: My understanding — volumetric boxes with different functions combined into an organic, coherent form, and floors whose layouts exist independently of one another.
Case modeling extrapolation — mobile space and free plan, “vast vision”, against room-like space, “cultivated inner vision”.

zh-Hant.heading: 研究
zh-Hant.body: 一座可居住的美術館，內部動線必須完全錯開，讓主人在休息與創作時不會遇到觀展者。案例研究比較 Adolf Loos 的 Raumplan——如房間般、培養內在視野的空間——與 Le Corbusier 的 Plan Libre——流動空間與自由平面、開闊的視野——並為兩者建立模型。
captions: 我的理解——不同機能的量體盒子組合成有機而連貫的形體，以及各層平面彼此獨立的配置。
案例模型推演——流動空間與自由平面的「開闊視野」，對比如房間般空間的「培養內在視野」。

sections.heading: Development
sections.body: A circular form was chosen to extend the space and avoid the sense of division brought by regular geometry. Studies began with one rotating shaft, then counterclockwise rotation, then two and multiple rotary axes; two equal-sized circles were cut and divided so the volumes could be controlled, and four relations of private, shared and public space were tested.
captions: Concept development — one rotating shaft, counterclockwise rotation, two rotating axes and multiple rotary axes forming multiple forms.
Floor relationship — two intersecting circles, and the privacy types: external, intersected, separate and relationally redundant spaces.

zh-Hant.heading: 推演
zh-Hant.body: 選擇圓形，是為了延伸空間，避免規則幾何帶來的分割感。研究從單一旋轉軸開始，接著嘗試逆時針旋轉，再到兩個與多個旋轉軸；把兩個等大的圓切割、劃分，以便控制量體，並測試私密、共享與公共空間的四種關係。
captions: 概念發展——單一旋轉軸、逆時針旋轉、兩個旋轉軸，以及形成多種形體的多個旋轉軸。
樓層關係——兩個相交的圓，以及私密類型：外部、交錯、分離與關係冗餘的空間。

sections.heading: Outcome
sections.body: The site is a man-made forest with good air, a suitable slope and a strong sense of direction. On the three curved floors the routes of owner and visitors interlace: the first floor protects the owner's privacy, the second divides private and public more directly, and the third is an isolated paradise like a glass house in a sunny garden, while small doors let the owner slip into the crowd and observe the visitors.
captions: Site analysis — about 500 square metres with an elevation difference of about 10 metres, a banyan tree, a river and a small bridge across the street.
Floor plans — showroom, garden, kitchen, parlor and privacy on the ground floor; guest room, living room and master bedroom on the second; bathroom and studio on the third.
Streamlines and materials — the owner's route is staggered from the visitors', and a wall of concrete bricks, heat shield, connecting parts and decorative panels.

zh-Hant.heading: 成果
zh-Hant.body: 基地是一片人造林，空氣良好、坡度合適，方向感強烈。在三層弧形樓層中，主人與參觀者的路線彼此交錯：一樓保護主人的隱私；二樓更直接地劃分私密與公共；三樓則是完全隔絕的樂園，如同陽光花園中的玻璃屋；小門則讓主人能悄悄混入人群、觀察參觀者。
captions: 基地分析——面積約 500 平方公尺、高差約 10 公尺，有一棵榕樹、一條河，以及一座跨越街道的小橋。
平面——一樓為展廳、花園、廚房、會客室與私密空間；二樓為客房、起居室與主臥；三樓為浴室與工作室。
動線與材料——主人的路線與參觀者錯開，以及由混凝土磚、隔熱層、連接件與裝飾板構成的牆體。

sections.heading: How I Teach This Method
sections.body:
1. Design for yourself first: your own habits and paintings are honest research.
2. Read two masters side by side: Raumplan and Plan Libre give two ways to divide space.
3. Find a rule for the form: rotating axes and intersecting circles keep the volumes under control.
4. Plan the routes before the rooms: staggered movement is what makes privacy possible.

zh-Hant.heading: 我如何教這套方法
zh-Hant.body:
1. 先為自己設計：自己的習慣與畫作，就是誠實的研究。
2. 並讀兩位大師：Raumplan 與 Plan Libre 提供兩種劃分空間的方式。
3. 為形體找到規則：旋轉軸與相交的圓，讓量體保持在掌控之中。
4. 先規劃動線，再安排房間：錯開的動線，才讓隱私成為可能。

pins.title: Silent Habitation — Learning from the Beaver
pins.description:
A scrapyard on a river in Stockport becomes an ecological park and beaver research centre, with researchers' houses raised above the habitat.

Stockport, England, UK | Residence + parks | Nov 2024 | Student Project | Design Director: Yu Chun Tsai (full-cycle supervision)

zh-Hant.title: 靜默棲居——向河狸學習
zh-Hant.description:
Stockport 河畔的一處廢料場，化身為生態公園與河狸研究中心，研究員住宅則架高於棲地之上。

英國 Stockport｜住宅＋公園｜2024 年 11 月｜學生作品｜設計總監 Yu Chun Tsai，全程指導

captions: Handmade model: the elevated research houses above the new river channel and the sunken ecological park.
手工模型：架高的研究員住宅，位於新河道與下沉式生態公園之上。

sections.heading: Problem
sections.body: The site is a scrapyard in Stockport, a small town south of Manchester, England, with a river running through it just upstream of the confluence of two rivers, and the scrapyard has polluted the river and divided the town's green space. Beavers were almost completely extinct in the UK in the late 16th century, mainly through overhunting, habitat loss and changes in water management, and in recent years they have gradually been reintroduced.
captions: Site analysis — the scrapyard on the river, with the surrounding buildings, transport and green space.

Strategies for ecological restoration — clean up the waste stations and river, restore park green space as corridors, build a beaver research centre, and form an ecological environment of natural symbiosis.

zh-Hant.heading: 問題
zh-Hant.body: 基地是英國曼徹斯特以南小鎮 Stockport 的一處廢料場，有一條河流穿過，位於兩河交匯處的上游，而廢料場污染了河流，也割裂了小鎮的綠地。河狸在 16 世紀末幾乎在英國絕跡，主因是過度獵捕、棲地喪失與水資源管理的改變；近年來，河狸逐漸被重新引入。
captions: 基地分析——河畔的廢料場，以及周邊建築、交通與綠地。
生態修復策略——清理垃圾站與河道、恢復公園綠地並形成綠色廊道、興建河狸研究中心，最終形成自然共生的生態環境。

sections.heading: Research
sections.body: Beavers build dams across rivers and streams, creating wetlands that purify water, control floods and provide habitat for many aquatic species. The project learns from them: a second river channel is opened on the site of the old scrapyard, the ground is lowered into a gentle slope as beaver habitat, and the islands it creates divide public and private space.
captions: Site design — river regulation and habitat, human activity paths, and the sections integrating the research centre, the elevated housing and the sunken park.
Block design — single, cutting, repeat and stacking, weighing users, privacy and views of the park.

zh-Hant.heading: 研究
zh-Hant.body: 河狸在河川與溪流上築壩，形成能淨化水質、調節洪水，並為多種水生物種提供棲地的濕地。本案向河狸學習：在舊廢料場的位置開出第二條河道，把地面降低成緩坡作為河狸棲地，並以由此形成的島嶼劃分公共與私密空間。
captions: 基地設計——河道調整與棲地、人的活動路徑，以及整合研究中心、架高住宅與下沉公園的剖面。
量體設計——單一、切割、重複與堆疊，權衡使用人數、隱私與觀看公園的視野。

sections.heading: Development
sections.body: The research and visitor centre sits in the middle, built to the terrain and linked by bridges, with a corridor above the new river. Three houses above it meet the researchers' living needs; each has its own small garden overlooking the park, south-facing windows and a façade that keeps residents' privacy, while the elevation avoids blocking park visitors' views.
captions: Axonometric and exploded view — roof garden, residential interior, laboratory, river landscape and plan.
Structure — steel beams, columns and support rods with bolted connections carry the building; wood forms the walls and floors, with sunshades in the façade frame.

zh-Hant.heading: 推演
zh-Hant.body: 研究中心與遊客中心依地形設於中央，以橋相連，新河道上方加設一條廊道。其上的三棟住宅滿足研究員的居住需求：每棟都有俯瞰公園的小花園、朝南的窗，以及保護住戶隱私的立面；架高的設計則不遮擋公園遊客的視線。
captions: 軸測與爆炸圖——屋頂花園、住宅室內、實驗室、河岸景觀與平面。
結構——鋼梁、柱與支撐桿以螺栓接合承重；木材構成牆體與樓板，並以遮陽板組成立面框架。

sections.heading: Outcome
sections.body: The final ecological park is open to the public, where people can watch the beavers at work. The building learns the technique and structure of beaver dams, and the reshaped site makes it easier for beavers to build their dams and purify the water in a natural way, so that people and nature coexist.
captions: Roof, interior and overview — wood and metal roof, a warm wooden interior with a small office for researchers, and the multi-block upper floor with open terraces.
Building elevation and perspective of the houses above the beaver habitat.
Model views.

zh-Hant.heading: 成果
zh-Hant.body: 最終的生態公園向公眾開放，人們可以觀察河狸活動。建築學習河狸築壩的技術與構造；改造後的基地讓河狸更容易築壩，並以自然的方式淨化水質，讓人與自然共存。
captions: 屋頂、室內與全景——木與金屬屋頂、設有研究員小辦公區的溫暖木質室內，以及由多個量體與開放露台組成的上層。
建築立面，以及河狸棲地上方住宅的透視。
模型視角。

sections.heading: How I Teach This Method
sections.body:
1. Learn from another builder: a beaver's dam is the brief's first precedent.
2. Repair the site before you build on it: clean up, regrade, reconnect the green.
3. Separate by landform: islands, slopes and elevation divide public and private.
4. Let the structure echo the idea: beams and rods built up like a dam.

zh-Hant.heading: 我如何教這套方法
zh-Hant.body:
1. 向另一位建造者學習：河狸的壩就是第一個參考案例。
2. 先修復基地，再在上面建造：清理、整地、重新連接綠地。
3. 以地形劃分：島嶼、坡地與高差區分公共與私密。
4. 讓結構呼應概念：梁與桿件像築壩一樣層層搭起。

pins.title: Celebration of Vertical — Exploring the Power of Height
pins.description:
An abandoned tower in Tianhe is renovated into homes and greenhouses inside an outer frame, collecting and reusing rainwater from the roof down.

Tianhe, Guangzhou, China | Residence | Oct 2024 | Student Project | Design Director: Yu Chun Tsai (full-cycle supervision)

zh-Hant.title: 垂直禮讚——探索高度的力量
zh-Hant.description:
天河一棟廢棄高樓被改造為外框之內的住宅與溫室，從屋頂開始收集並再利用雨水。

中國廣州天河｜住宅｜2024 年 10 月｜學生作品｜設計總監 Yu Chun Tsai，全程指導

captions: Handmade model of the renovated tower: residential floors and greenhouses hung inside an external frame.
改造高樓的手工模型：住宅樓層與溫室懸掛於外部框架之內。

sections.heading: Problem
sections.body: As a rapidly developing city, Guangzhou has seen a gap between urban and rural areas that shows not only in economic and social development but also in the allocation of environmental resources, while pollution and ecological degradation need to be addressed urgently. The number of migrants in Guangzhou has exceeded 10 million and housing shortages are growing, so the project renovates an abandoned building in a busy area.
captions: Site — the abandoned tower beside the stadiums and playground, between Linhexi Road and Bauhinia Road.
Abandoned building — the growth of the migrant population and the proportion of migrants in Guangzhou.

zh-Hant.heading: 問題
zh-Hant.body: 廣州作為快速發展的城市，城鄉之間逐漸出現落差，不僅反映在經濟與社會發展上，也反映在環境資源的分配上；同時，污染與生態退化亦亟待解決。廣州的流動人口已超過一千萬，住房短缺日益突出，因此本案改造一棟位於繁忙地段的廢棄建築。
captions: 基地——廢棄高樓位於體育場與運動場旁，介於林和西路與紫荊路之間。
廢棄建築——廣州流動人口的成長，以及流動人口所佔的比例。

sections.heading: Research
sections.body: Greening has to reach every part of urban construction, through roof gardens, vertical greening and green buildings, so that the city can develop more sustainably and become more livable. Rainwater is collected, stored, purified for domestic use and turned into artificial rainfall for the lower buildings, and the cooling structure condenses water vapour back into pure water.
captions: Rainwater cycle — collection, storage, purification and reuse for watering, domestic water and heating.
Architectural space and function — half of the living area becomes greenhouses: water collection and storage, residences, public spaces, shopping and water treatment.

zh-Hant.heading: 研究
zh-Hant.body: 綠化必須融入城市建設的各個面向——屋頂花園、垂直綠化與綠建築——讓城市更永續、更宜居。雨水經收集、儲存、淨化後供生活使用，也化為人工降雨為下方建築降溫；冷卻結構則把水氣凝結回純水。
captions: 雨水循環——收集、儲存、淨化，再用於澆灌、生活用水與供暖。
建築空間與機能——一半的居住面積轉為溫室：集水與儲水、住宅、公共空間、商場與水處理。

sections.heading: Development
sections.body: Greenhouses grow vegetables, fruit, herbs and flowers in a planting system watered by the collection system, with automatic control of temperature, humidity, light and irrigation. Apartments of irregular shapes and rooms of different sizes meet the residents' needs, high-altitude greenhouses improve air circulation, and an external support frame keeps the tower from tipping over.
captions: Planting system and air exchange — greenhouses separated from the living area by irregular rooms, shown in section.
Partition function — commercial and public ground floor, randomly distributed planting and residential areas, water storage and a viewing platform on top.

zh-Hant.heading: 推演
zh-Hant.body: 溫室以集水系統澆灌的種植系統栽種蔬菜、水果、香草與花卉，並自動調節溫度、濕度、光照與灌溉。形狀不規則的公寓與大小不一的房間滿足住戶需求；高空溫室改善空氣流通，外部支撐框架則防止高樓因頂部過重而傾倒。
captions: 種植系統與空氣交換——以剖面呈現由不規則房間與居住區分隔的溫室。
分區機能——一樓為商業與公共空間，中段隨機分布種植區與住宅，頂部設儲水結構與觀景平台。

sections.heading: Outcome
sections.body: The roof slopes towards the middle and collects rainwater like a funnel into a storage tank, and a glass outer layer on its own frame forms a roof greenhouse with a landscape plaza. Residences and greenhouses rise through the tower inside the outer frame, with commercial and public spaces at its base.
captions: Roof greenhouse — the glass outer layer, its frame, the rainwater collection system and the functional distribution.
Residential areas and greenhouses, and commercial and public spaces.
Overview of the renovated tower.

zh-Hant.heading: 成果
zh-Hant.body: 屋頂向中央傾斜，像漏斗般把雨水收集進儲水槽；由獨立框架支撐的玻璃外層，形成設有景觀廣場的屋頂溫室。住宅與溫室在外框之內貫穿整棟高樓，底部則是商業與公共空間。
captions: 屋頂溫室——玻璃外層與其框架、雨水收集系統與機能分布。
住宅區與溫室，以及商業與公共空間。
改造後高樓的全景。

sections.heading: How I Teach This Method
sections.body:
1. Find the building nobody uses: an abandoned tower is a site, not a problem.
2. Follow the water first: collection, storage and reuse set the section.
3. Give the plants half: greenhouses and homes share every floor.
4. Let the frame carry the idea: an outer structure holds the vertical garden.

zh-Hant.heading: 我如何教這套方法
zh-Hant.body:
1. 找出沒人使用的建築：一棟廢棄高樓是基地，而不是問題。
2. 先追隨水：收集、儲存與再利用決定了剖面。
3. 把一半留給植物：溫室與住宅共享每一層。
4. 讓框架承載概念：外部結構撐起垂直花園。

pins.title: Bridges of Humanity — Building Beyond Boundaries
pins.description:
A spiral, multi-layer bridge and square at Luohu that eases cross-border traffic between Shenzhen and Hong Kong and promotes exchange.

Luohu, Shenzhen–Hong Kong boundary | Memorial plaza | Aug 2024 | Student Project | Design Director: Yu Chun Tsai (full-cycle supervision)

zh-Hant.title: 人性之橋——超越邊界的建造
zh-Hant.description:
在羅湖設計一座螺旋狀的多層橋與廣場，紓解深港之間的跨境交通，並促進交流。

深港邊界羅湖｜紀念廣場｜2024 年 8 月｜學生作品｜設計總監 Yu Chun Tsai，全程指導

captions: Aerial render: a spiral, multi-layer bridge joining the two sides at Luohu.
鳥瞰渲染：一座螺旋狀的多層橋，連接羅湖的兩岸。

sections.heading: Problem
sections.body: Because of the history of Hong Kong's division, checkpoints have caused a serious separation between the development of northern Hong Kong and Shenzhen, and Luohu, the largest checkpoint, faces problems of passenger flow and traffic. Luohu Port also suffers from ageing infrastructure, poor environmental management, a single function and insufficient cross-border collaboration, which lead to low clearance efficiency and a poor experience for residents and visitors.
captions: Road analysis, land use (commercial, residential, green space) and customs at Luohu.
History of Hong Kong — the boundary between Shenzhen and Hong Kong.

zh-Hant.heading: 問題
zh-Hant.body: 由於香港分治的歷史，口岸造成香港北部與深圳的發展嚴重割裂；最大的口岸羅湖，面臨客流與交通的問題。羅湖口岸還有基礎設施老化、環境管理不佳、機能單一與跨境協作不足等問題，導致通關效率低落，居民與旅客的體驗也不佳。
captions: 羅湖的道路分析、土地使用（商業、住宅、綠地）與海關。
香港的歷史——深圳與香港之間的邊界。

sections.heading: Research
sections.body: The policy of “one country, two systems” was set in 1984 to remain unchanged for 50 years, which raises the question of what may change by 2034. The project is a square with a bridge that improves the traffic problems and promotes cross-border exchange.
captions: Generation — connect, circle, centre and interlace the routes between the two sides.

zh-Hant.heading: 研究
zh-Hant.body: 「一國兩制」於 1984 年確立，承諾五十年不變，令人思考到了 2034 年是否會有所改變。本案是一座廣場與橋，用以改善交通問題，並促進跨境交流。
captions: 生成——連接、環繞、聚中，再讓兩岸之間的路徑交織。

sections.heading: Development
sections.body: The building generation process gradually forms a spiral, multi-layer path structure. The design focuses on the openness and permeability of the space, reflecting the connection between the two sides.
captions: On the paths — the layered decks open to the river and the city.

zh-Hant.heading: 推演
zh-Hant.body: 建築的生成過程逐步形成一個螺旋狀的多層路徑結構。設計著重空間的開放性與穿透性，以呼應兩岸之間的連結。
captions: 在路徑上——層層平台向河流與城市敞開。

sections.heading: Outcome
sections.body: The spiral bridge organises traffic and people flow efficiently across the boundary. It shows the unity of function and beauty.

zh-Hant.heading: 成果
zh-Hant.body: 螺旋橋高效地組織跨越邊界的交通與人流。它展現了機能與美的統一。

sections.heading: How I Teach This Method
sections.body:
1. Start from a border: history explains why the two sides grew apart.
2. Ask a question with a date: what changes by 2034?
3. Draw the movement before the form: connect, circle, centre, interlace.
4. Make the bridge a place: openness and permeability, not just passage.

zh-Hant.heading: 我如何教這套方法
zh-Hant.body:
1. 從一條邊界出發：歷史說明了兩岸為何分道揚鑣。
2. 提出一個有日期的問題：到 2034 年會改變什麼？
3. 先畫移動，再畫形體：連接、環繞、聚中、交織。
4. 讓橋成為一個場所：開放與穿透，而不只是通道。

pins.title: Re-Imagine Metabolism — Rebuild the Nakagin Capsule Tower
pins.description:
On the original site of the Nakagin Capsule Tower, capsules become movable rooms that circle each floor and ride the elevator shaft.

Original site of the Nakagin Capsule Tower, Tokyo, Japan | Residence | Dec 2024 | Student Project | Design Director: Yu Chun Tsai (full-cycle supervision)

zh-Hant.title: 重新想像代謝派——重建中銀膠囊塔
zh-Hant.description:
在中銀膠囊塔的原址，膠囊成為可移動的房間：在每層樓環行，並沿電梯井上下。

日本東京中銀膠囊塔原址｜住宅｜2024 年 12 月｜學生作品｜設計總監 Yu Chun Tsai，全程指導

captions: Model of the rebuilt tower: capsules slide into a ring-shaped steel frame.
重建高塔的模型：膠囊單元滑入環形的鋼構框架。

sections.heading: Problem
sections.body: The project aims to revitalise the iconic mid-20th-century Japanese Nakagin Capsule Tower through modern technology and innovative design, reflecting on the architectural concept of Metabolism. As a standout example of the Metabolism movement, a post-war Japanese movement that fused ideas of megastructures with organic growth, the tower embodies modularity and flexibility.
captions: Figure-ground — the original site of the tower in its city block.
Outcome — the new tower in its block.

zh-Hant.heading: 問題
zh-Hant.body: 本案希望以現代科技與創新設計，讓 20 世紀中期的日本代表性建築中銀膠囊塔重獲新生，並反思代謝派的建築概念。作為代謝派——一個融合巨型結構與有機成長概念的日本戰後建築運動——的代表作，這座塔體現了模組化與彈性。
captions: 圖底關係——高塔在街廓中的原址。
成果——新高塔與其所在街廓。

sections.heading: Research
sections.body: The project sits on the original site of the Nakagin Capsule Tower and uses existing technology to move and update the capsules. Each capsule unit is an independent, movable room.
captions: Plans — roof garden, residential layer and basement.
Section and circulation — a capsule moves in a circle on its layer and up or down the elevator shaft.

zh-Hant.heading: 研究
zh-Hant.body: 本案位於中銀膠囊塔的原址，運用既有技術讓膠囊得以移動與更新。每個膠囊單元都是一間獨立、可移動的房間。
captions: 平面——屋頂花園、住宅層與地下室。
剖面與動線——膠囊在所在樓層環形移動，並沿電梯井上下移動。

sections.heading: Development
sections.body: A capsule can move horizontally in a circular motion and vertically after reaching the elevator shaft, so it can reach the rooftop garden or the basement. The tower is built up from a vertical steel frame, outer and inner residential units with their support structures, a central circulation tube, the elevator shaft and a roof garden.
captions: Exploded structure — roof garden, elevator shaft, central circulation tube, inner and outer residential units and the vertical steel frame.
The capsule unit — axonometric, plan and two cut perspectives.

zh-Hant.heading: 推演
zh-Hant.body: 膠囊可以環形水平移動，抵達電梯井後再垂直移動，因此能到達屋頂花園或地下室。高塔由垂直鋼構框架、內外兩圈住宅單元與其支撐結構、中央動線筒、電梯井與屋頂花園組成。
captions: 爆炸結構——屋頂花園、電梯井、中央動線筒、內外住宅單元與垂直鋼構框架。
膠囊單元——軸測、平面與兩個剖切透視。

sections.heading: Outcome
sections.body: The elevation shows the capsules held in the curved steel frame above a solid base. The model was built in metal so that the capsules can be taken out and put back, like the tower's own renewal.
captions: Elevation of the rebuilt tower.
Model details — capsules in the ring frame.

zh-Hant.heading: 成果
zh-Hant.body: 立面呈現膠囊被弧形鋼構框架托住，立於實體基座之上。模型以金屬製作，讓膠囊可以取出再放回，就像高塔本身的更新。
captions: 重建高塔的立面。
模型細部——環形框架中的膠囊。

sections.heading: How I Teach This Method
sections.body:
1. Read the idea behind the icon: Metabolism promised change, so design for it.
2. Keep the site, change the system: the same ground, new ways to move.
3. Design the unit and its route together: a room that travels.
4. Build a model that works: capsules you can actually take out.

zh-Hant.heading: 我如何教這套方法
zh-Hant.body:
1. 讀懂經典背後的理念：代謝派承諾改變，那就為改變而設計。
2. 保留基地，改變系統：同一塊地，新的移動方式。
3. 同時設計單元與其路徑：一個會旅行的房間。
4. 做一個真的能動的模型：膠囊真的可以取出。

pins.title: Mangrove – Wetland – Sandbeach — Renewing the Shenzhen Airport Wharf
pins.description:
A desolate space where two expressways meet at the Shenzhen Airport wharf becomes a mangrove wetland and beach for ecological education and play.

Shenzhen Airport Wharf, Shenzhen, China | Landscape design / mangrove wetland, ecological education | Student Project | Design Director: Yu Chun Tsai (full-cycle supervision)

zh-Hant.title: 紅樹林・濕地・沙灘——深圳機場碼頭改造
zh-Hant.description:
深圳機場碼頭旁、兩條高速公路交會處的荒涼空地，化身為兼具生態教育與遊憩的紅樹林濕地與沙灘。

中國深圳機場碼頭｜景觀設計／紅樹林濕地、生態教育｜學生作品｜設計總監 Yu Chun Tsai，全程指導

captions: Handmade model at 1:1000: mangroves, the boardwalk, the dock and the wetland museum.
1:1000 手工模型：紅樹林、棧道、碼頭與濕地博物館。

sections.heading: Problem
sections.body: The site is an open space near the wharf of Shenzhen Airport, where two expressways converge, and although many people pass through it every day, it is relatively desolate. Only two highways connect it, pile drivers on the reclaimed land blow dust towards the coastal homes, and the green areas around it are not connected.
captions: Site — the open space at the wharf between the expressways, the railway station, the airport and the mangrove park.

Problems and design strategies — low accessibility, reclamation pollution and ecological fragmentation, answered by an ecological corridor, an education museum with rest facilities, and natural sediment storage.

zh-Hant.heading: 問題
zh-Hant.body: 基地位於深圳機場碼頭附近的一片空地，兩條高速公路在此交會；雖然每天有大量人流經過，基地卻相當荒涼。只有兩條公路連通此地，填海工地的打樁機把塵土吹向沿岸住宅，周邊的綠地也彼此不相連。
captions: 基地——碼頭旁的空地，位於高速公路、火車站、機場與紅樹林公園之間。
問題與設計策略——可達性低、填海污染與生態破碎，對應生態廊道、附設休憩設施的生態教育館，以及自然沉積空間。

sections.heading: Research
sections.body: The site lies at a brackish water junction suited to mangroves and wetland plant communities, and a wetland park with mangroves along the coastline is nearby. Mangrove ecology runs from the subtidal to the supratidal zone, where birds, fish, invertebrates, benthos and microorganisms live among true mangroves and companion plants.
captions: Mangrove ecology — the tidal zones from subtidal to supratidal, with true mangroves and companion plants.

zh-Hant.heading: 研究
zh-Hant.body: 基地位於鹹淡水交匯處，適合紅樹林與濕地植物群落生長，附近還有一座沿海岸線長滿紅樹林的濕地公園。紅樹林生態從潮下帶延伸到潮上帶，鳥類、魚類、無脊椎動物、底棲生物與微生物，棲息在真紅樹與伴生植物之間。
captions: 紅樹林生態——從潮下帶到潮上帶，以及真紅樹與伴生植物。

sections.heading: Development
sections.body: The mangroves along the nearby coastline are extended to the site, more wetland plants are planted and sandy beaches are accumulated, turning the site into a rest area for ecological education and entertainment. The plan grows in three stages, from a low-impact design through the design proposal to a future envision, with ecological corridors, different functional areas and natural sediment storage.
captions: Stage plans — low-impact design, the design proposal (recreational facilities, quay, wooden trestle, wetland flora, wetland museum, temporary parking, sandbeach) and the future envision.
Methods — ecological corridors, different functional areas and natural sediment storage space.

zh-Hant.heading: 推演
zh-Hant.body: 把附近海岸線的紅樹林延伸到基地，種植更多濕地植物並堆積沙灘，讓基地成為兼具生態教育與休閒娛樂的休憩區。計畫分三個階段生長：從低衝擊設計、設計方案到未來願景，並以生態廊道、不同機能分區與自然沉積空間推進。
captions: 階段平面——低衝擊設計、設計方案（休閒設施、碼頭、木棧道、濕地植物、濕地博物館、臨時停車場、沙灘）與未來願景。
方法——生態廊道、不同機能分區與自然沉積空間。

sections.heading: Outcome
sections.body: In the wetland area people can observe the ecological community of mangrove plants and feel the ebb and flow of the tide. In the recreational beach area they can enjoy relaxing activities such as canoeing and beach volleyball.
captions: Wetland perspective — the boardwalk among mangroves and wetland plants.
Sandbeach perspective — canoes and the beach in front of the city.

zh-Hant.heading: 成果
zh-Hant.body: 在濕地區，人們可以觀察紅樹林植物的生態群落，感受潮起潮落。在休閒沙灘區，人們可以享受划獨木舟、沙灘排球等輕鬆的活動。
captions: 濕地透視——穿行於紅樹林與濕地植物之間的棧道。
沙灘透視——城市前方的獨木舟與沙灘。

sections.heading: How I Teach This Method
sections.body:
1. Read the edge: brackish water decides what can grow.
2. Pair problems with advantages: each issue gets a strategy.
3. Plan in stages: low impact first, the future later.
4. Model the landscape by hand to understand its structure.

zh-Hant.heading: 我如何教這套方法
zh-Hant.body:
1. 讀懂邊界：鹹淡水決定了什麼能生長。
2. 讓問題與優勢配對：每個問題都對應一個策略。
3. 分階段規劃：先低衝擊，未來再擴展。
4. 親手製作地景模型，理解它的結構。

pins.title: Draw Healing Power from Plants
pins.description:
Beside the church of Longyearbyen in the Arctic, stone walls guide the river so that flower fields can grow and help residents heal from depression.

Longyearbyen, Svalbard, Norway | Landscape design | Student Project | Design Director: Yu Chun Tsai (full-cycle supervision)

zh-Hant.title: 從植物汲取療癒力量
zh-Hant.description:
在北極朗伊爾城的教堂旁，以石牆引導河水，讓花田得以生長，協助居民從憂鬱中療癒。

挪威斯瓦巴群島朗伊爾城｜景觀設計｜學生作品｜設計總監 Yu Chun Tsai，全程指導

captions: The 2040 plan: flower fields grown along the river, with the prayer garden across from the church.
2040 年平面：花田沿河生長，祈禱花園與教堂隔河相望。

sections.heading: Problem
sections.body: Longyearbyen, located in the Arctic, is extremely cold and relatively lacking in vegetation, and many of its residents suffer from depression or anxiety. Interviews with 952 local residents with depression syndrome show how the scarcity of plants affects both people and the environment.
captions: Site location — Longyearbyen in Svalbard, inside the Arctic Circle.
Prevalence of depression among Russian and Norwegian residents, and the effects of plant scarcity on people and the environment.

zh-Hant.heading: 問題
zh-Hant.body: 位於北極圈的朗伊爾城極為寒冷、植被稀少，許多居民受憂鬱或焦慮所苦。對 952 位有憂鬱症狀的當地居民所做的訪談，呈現了植物匱乏對人與環境的影響。
captions: 基地位置——北極圈內斯瓦巴群島的朗伊爾城。
俄羅斯與挪威居民的憂鬱盛行率，以及植物匱乏對人與環境的影響。

sections.heading: Research
sections.body: The church is open 24 hours and often hosts religious services and community events, so people come here for spiritual support. The river beside it was divided into three sections, and the water volume was found to be larger near the upper reaches and to become shallower and more dispersed towards the middle and lower reaches.
captions: Longyearbyen map — the church, green land, public infrastructure and the stream sections A–G.
River profile — the sections from the fjord to the glacier.

zh-Hant.heading: 研究
zh-Hant.body: 教堂 24 小時開放，經常舉辦宗教儀式與社區活動，人們來這裡尋求心靈支持。教堂旁的河流被分為三段研究，發現上游水量較大，往中下游則逐漸變淺並分散。
captions: 朗伊爾城地圖——教堂、綠地、公共設施與 A–G 河道剖面。
河道剖面——從峽灣到冰川的各段剖面。

sections.heading: Development
sections.body: A 50 × 30 × 10 cm model of river sand, grass, coal, stone and ice tested four river forms of the region: dry season, wet season, ice flow and seasonal flood. The tests showed that water and stones shape the river bed, rivers transport material, vegetation blocks it and plant roots protect the terrain.
captions: Simulated river flow test — dry season, wet season, ice flow and seasonal flood, with the conclusions of each.
2025 — stone walls of local stone control the flow of water, with flower fields where the water passes.

zh-Hant.heading: 推演
zh-Hant.body: 以河沙、草、煤、石與冰製作的 50 × 30 × 10 公分模型，測試了當地四種河流型態：旱季、雨季、冰流與季節性洪水。實驗發現水與石塑造河床、河流搬運物質、植被阻擋物質，而植物根系保護地形。
captions: 模擬河流實驗——旱季、雨季、冰流與季節性洪水，以及各自的結論。
2025 年——以當地石材砌成的石牆控制水流，並在水流經之處布置花田。

sections.heading: Outcome
sections.body: With the seasonal melting of snow and the nourishment of the river, the plants gradually grow, and people can admire the flowers, see the church across the river from the resting space of the flower field and pray here. Local plants were selected for the five sections of the site, on its permafrost, rock and river mud.
captions: Five sections of the site and the site plants selection.
The first sunshine of 2040 — a ray of sunshine through the clouds over the valley.

zh-Hant.heading: 成果
zh-Hant.body: 隨著季節性融雪與河水滋養，植物逐漸生長；人們可以賞花，從花田的休憩空間望向對岸的教堂，並在此祈禱。依基地五個剖面的永凍土、岩石與河泥，選用了當地的植物。
captions: 基地五個剖面與基地植物選擇。
2040 年的第一道陽光——穿透雲層照進山谷的一道陽光。

sections.heading: How I Teach This Method
sections.body:
1. Start from people's health: data on depression defines the problem.
2. Find where people already gather: the church is the anchor.
3. Test the river with a physical model before drawing the plan.
4. Design in time: 2025 sets the walls, 2040 grows the flowers.

zh-Hant.heading: 我如何教這套方法
zh-Hant.body:
1. 從人的健康出發：憂鬱數據界定了問題。
2. 找出人們已經聚集的地方：教堂就是錨點。
3. 畫平面之前，先用實體模型測試河流。
4. 在時間中設計：2025 年砌牆，2040 年花開。

pins.title: Save White Dolphin
pins.description:
Floating islands with sonar devices at Neilingding Island give white dolphins food and keep them away from the ships of the Pearl River Estuary.

Neilingding Island, Pearl River Estuary, China | Ecological device | Student Project | Design Director: Yu Chun Tsai (full-cycle supervision)

zh-Hant.title: 拯救白海豚
zh-Hant.description:
在內伶仃島設置裝有聲納的浮島，為白海豚提供食物，並讓牠們避開珠江口的船隻。

中國珠江口內伶仃島｜生態裝置｜學生作品｜設計總監 Yu Chun Tsai，全程指導

captions: Sonar off, sonar on: dolphins feed around the floating islands, then swim away from the boats when the sonar turns on.
聲納關閉與開啟：海豚在浮島周圍覓食，聲納開啟時則游離船隻。

sections.heading: Problem
sections.body: The survival of white dolphins is in crisis because of human activities at sea, so the project takes protective measures at Neilingding Island, where white dolphins appear frequently. Garbage pollution, offshore sand mining, abandoned fishing nets, accidental catch, ship propellers and vessel noise all threaten their lives.
captions: Location — the site in the Pearl River Estuary between Zhuhai, Macao, Shenzhen and Hong Kong, with the Chinese White Dolphin National Nature Reserve, its core, buffer and test areas, and the ship routes.
Habitat of the dolphin — a water depth of more than two metres, a safe distance from people, small fish as food, and how noise of 0–60, 60–90 and over 90 dB affects dolphins.

zh-Hant.heading: 問題
zh-Hant.body: 由於人類的海上活動，白海豚的生存陷入危機，因此本案在白海豚經常出沒的內伶仃島採取保護措施。垃圾污染、近海採砂、廢棄漁網、誤捕、船隻螺旋槳與船舶噪音，都威脅著牠們的生命。
captions: 基地——珠江口，介於珠海、澳門、深圳與香港之間，以及中華白海豚國家級自然保護區的核心區、緩衝區、實驗區與航道。
海豚棲地——兩公尺以上的水深、與人的安全距離、以小魚為食，以及 0–60、60–90 與 90 分貝以上的噪音對海豚的影響。

sections.heading: Research
sections.body: An early mind map traces the conflict between dolphins and people from their needs, food, habitat, profit and protection, through causes and problems to strategies. Domestic garbage calls for effective recycling, reclamation works for avoiding the habitat, and fishing activity for location hints.
captions: Early mind map and strategies — situation, need, demand, cause, problem, strategy and goal.
Structure location mapping — the device placed among the white dolphin sightings and the lines of ships.

zh-Hant.heading: 研究
zh-Hant.body: 早期的心智圖從海豚與人的需求——食物、棲地、利益與保護——出發，經由成因與問題，推導出策略。生活垃圾對應有效回收，填海工程對應避開棲地，捕魚活動則對應位置提示。
captions: 早期心智圖與策略——情境、需求、訴求、成因、問題、策略與目標。
裝置位置——裝置設於白海豚出沒點與航線之間。

sections.heading: Development
sections.body: The floating islands are placed where ship traffic is intensive and dolphins appear most often, each with a sonar device, in the hope of reducing dolphin injuries. Vegetation attracts fish, plant roots and algae purify the water, a surveillance system detects dolphin activity and the sonar turns on and off in phases.
captions: Existing situation and operation mode — materials from airport food waste and bioplastics, the coralliform device and the island structure.
Structure analysis — the vegetation and seagrass species on the island, and the coralliform device that feeds the seagrass.

zh-Hant.heading: 推演
zh-Hant.body: 浮島設於航運密集、海豚最常出沒的水域，每座都裝有聲納裝置，希望減少海豚受傷。植被吸引魚群，植物根系與藻類淨化水質，監測系統偵測海豚的活動位置，聲納則分階段開關。
captions: 現況與運作模式——取材自機場廚餘與生物塑膠，以及珊瑚狀裝置與島體構造。
結構分析——島上的植被與海草物種，以及滋養海草的珊瑚狀裝置。

sections.heading: Outcome
sections.body: When the sonar is off, the dolphins swim to the island to catch small fish and play near the device, and when it turns on during busy periods of fishing vessels and freighters, they swim away from the boats. The 1:50 physical model was made of resin, grass powder, gypsophila, river sand, stone and water grass.
captions: Physical model at 1:50 — the solar power system, the sonar device and the coralliform device.

zh-Hant.heading: 成果
zh-Hant.body: 聲納關閉時，海豚游到島邊捕捉小魚、在裝置附近嬉戲；在漁船與貨輪往來頻繁的時段聲納開啟，海豚便游離船隻。1:50 的實體模型以樹脂、草粉、滿天星、河沙、石頭與水草製作。
captions: 1:50 實體模型——太陽能系統、聲納裝置與珊瑚狀裝置。

sections.heading: How I Teach This Method
sections.body:
1. Design for another species: the white dolphin is the client.
2. Map the conflict before the form: needs, causes, problems, strategies.
3. Let the device work in time: the sonar turns on and off with the ships.
4. Test it in water: a physical model shows the island above and below.

zh-Hant.heading: 我如何教這套方法
zh-Hant.body:
1. 為另一個物種設計：白海豚就是業主。
2. 先畫出衝突，再談形式：需求、成因、問題、策略。
3. 讓裝置在時間中運作：聲納隨船隻開關。
4. 放進水裡測試：實體模型呈現島的水上與水下。

pins.title: PLEAT
pins.description:
Behind Block O of Macau University of Science and Technology, a folded garden gives students places to rest, play and socialise, from open to hidden.

Block O, Macau University of Science and Technology, Macao | Campus landscape | Student Project | Design Director: Yu Chun Tsai (full-cycle supervision)

zh-Hant.title: 摺
zh-Hant.description:
在澳門科技大學 O 座後方，一座摺疊的花園為學生提供從開放到隱密、可休息、遊戲與社交的空間。

澳門科技大學 O 座｜校園景觀｜學生作品｜設計總監 Yu Chun Tsai，全程指導

captions: Handmade model at 1:1000: the folded garden behind Block O, with its pavilions among the campus buildings.
1:1000 手工模型：O 座後方的摺疊花園，亭子散布在校園建築之間。

sections.heading: Problem
sections.body: The site lies behind Block O of Macau University of Science and Technology, an area mainly used for student activities, where about half of the ground is green and open space with low use. Considering that students love to play on their mobile phones, the project creates a place where they can both entertain themselves and socialise.
captions: Location — the site in Cotai, with Hengqin Port, Flores Park, Macau International Airport and the Dangzai Ferry Terminal within reach.
Macau land use planning, transportation accessibility and POI distribution around the site.

zh-Hant.heading: 問題
zh-Hant.body: 基地位於澳門科技大學 O 座後方，主要供學生活動使用，約一半是綠地與開放空間，但使用率很低。考量到學生喜歡滑手機，本案希望打造一個讓他們既能娛樂、也能社交的地方。
captions: 基地位置——路氹城區，鄰近橫琴口岸、花城公園、澳門國際機場與氹仔客運碼頭。
基地周邊的澳門土地使用規劃、交通可達性與 POI 分布。

sections.heading: Research
sections.body: Different groups of people, students, teachers, workers and visitors, have different purposes for their activities and different time periods for them. Macao has a subtropical monsoon climate with hot summers, high solar radiation and precipitation concentrated in summer, and the large, uneven ground has only a few drainage points.
captions: People and traffic flow behind Block O, the classification of people and the students' mobile phone time from morning to evening.
Site climate and illumination — wind, temperature, precipitation, humidity and direct sun hours; shading areas are needed.
Site drainage — rainwater wells, storm sewers, greenery and rainwater runoff.

zh-Hant.heading: 研究
zh-Hant.body: 學生、教師、職員與訪客等不同族群，各有不同的活動目的與主要活動時段。澳門屬亞熱帶季風氣候，夏季炎熱、日照輻射強、降雨集中於夏季；而基地面積大、地面不平，排水點卻很少。
captions: O 座後方的人流與車流、人群分類，以及學生從早到晚使用手機的時間。
基地氣候與日照——風、氣溫、降雨、濕度與直射日照時數；需要增設遮蔭區。
基地排水——雨水井、雨水管、綠地與地表逕流。

sections.heading: Development
sections.body: The privacy of landscape space comes from people's types of outdoor activity, purposeful behaviour, perception and distance, and private space should give people enough security. The concept comes from Gilles Deleuze's idea of the “fold”: constantly folded layers where public and private coexist, neither closed nor unobstructed, full of hidden corners.
captions: Design direction — safety, humanization, ecologicalization and regionalism for the renovation of the site.
Design sketches — the folded zones for greening, catering, gardening, activity, rest and waiting.

zh-Hant.heading: 推演
zh-Hant.body: 景觀空間的私密性，來自人們的戶外活動類型、目的性行為、感知與距離；私密空間應讓人獲得足夠的安全感。設計概念來自法國哲學家德勒茲的「摺曲」：不斷摺疊的層次讓公共與私密共存，既不封閉也不一覽無遺，充滿隱密的角落。
captions: 設計方向——以安全、人性化、生態化與地域性改造基地。
設計草圖——綠化、餐飲、園藝、活動、休息與等候的摺疊分區。

sections.heading: Outcome
sections.body: The master plan folds an art installation, reading, rest, garden, recreation, pickup, outdoor picnic and waiting areas along the site. Planting is configured for four kinds of introvert students, social, thinking, anxious and restrained, from open spaces for chats to covered spaces for meditation.
captions: Master plan — 1 art installation, 2 reading area, 3 rest area, 4 garden area, 5 recreation area, 6 pickup area, 7 outdoor picnic, 8 waiting area.
Vegetation design for introvert students and the plant configuration of trees, shrubs, herbage and hydrophytes.

zh-Hant.heading: 成果
zh-Hant.body: 總平面沿基地摺疊出藝術裝置、閱讀區、休息區、花園區、遊憩區、取件區、戶外野餐區與等候區。植栽依四種內向學生——社交型、思考型、焦慮型與克制型——配置，從聊天用的開放空間到冥想用的遮蔽空間。
captions: 總平面——1 藝術裝置、2 閱讀區、3 休息區、4 花園區、5 遊憩區、6 取件區、7 戶外野餐、8 等候區。
為內向學生設計的植栽，以及喬木、灌木、草本與水生植物的配置。

sections.heading: How I Teach This Method
sections.body:
1. Watch who uses the site, and when: students, teachers, workers, visitors.
2. Read the climate as a brief: sun and rain set the shade and drainage.
3. Borrow a concept and draw it: the fold becomes the plan.
4. Plant for people: each kind of introvert gets its own space.

zh-Hant.heading: 我如何教這套方法
zh-Hant.body:
1. 觀察誰在何時使用基地：學生、教師、職員、訪客。
2. 把氣候當成任務書：日照與降雨決定遮蔭與排水。
3. 借用一個概念並把它畫出來：摺曲成為平面。
4. 為人種植：每一種內向者都有自己的空間。

pins.title: Children's Healing Garden
pins.description:
A neglected garden at a Guangzhou children's hospital becomes pocket and roof gardens for play, healing and rest, designed around children's height and senses.

Guangzhou Women and Children's Medical Center, Guangzhou, China | Garden design | Nov 2021 | Student Project | Design Director: Yu Chun Tsai (full-cycle supervision)

zh-Hant.title: 兒童療癒花園
zh-Hant.description:
廣州一所兒童醫院裡荒廢的花園，化身為依兒童身高與感官設計、可遊戲、療癒與休憩的口袋花園與屋頂花園。

中國廣州市婦女兒童醫療中心｜花園設計｜2021 年 11 月｜學生作品｜設計總監 Yu Chun Tsai，全程指導

captions: Master plan: pocket gardens and a roof garden woven through the hospital, from the spiral garden to the water pump and rolling meadow.
總平面：口袋花園與屋頂花園穿插於醫院之間，從螺旋花園到水泵與起伏草地。

sections.heading: Problem
sections.body: The site is a 4,369 m² garden at the Guangzhou Women and Children's Medical Center, used by sick children, their families, hospital staff and the neighbourhood. Its existing condition shows low playability, low safety, site neglect, a lack of age-inclusive landscape and untidy vegetation.
captions: Site location — the medical center in Yuexiu District, with the schools, kindergartens, commercial centre and parks within 300, 500 and 800 m.
User analysis — sick children, families, staff and neighbours — and the location analysis of buildings, roads and existing trees.

zh-Hant.heading: 問題
zh-Hant.body: 基地是廣州市婦女兒童醫療中心內一處 4,369 平方公尺的花園，使用者包括病童、病童家屬、醫護人員與鄰里居民。現況存在可玩性低、安全性低、場地荒廢、缺乏全齡友善景觀與植栽雜亂等問題。
captions: 基地位置——越秀區的醫療中心，以及 300、500 與 800 公尺範圍內的學校、幼兒園、商業中心與公園。
使用者分析——病童、家屬、醫護人員與鄰里——以及建築、道路與既有樹木的區位分析。

sections.heading: Research
sections.body: Children's identity was studied through their average height at ages 0–3, 4–6 and 7–14, their social distance and their behaviours, from walking and climbing to sharing and celebrating. Colour psychology links blue, green, yellow, orange, purple and white to feelings such as calmness, growth, happiness and creativity.
captions: Children's identity — average height, social distance, behaviour and colour psychology.

zh-Hant.heading: 研究
zh-Hant.body: 從 0–3、4–6 與 7–14 歲兒童的平均身高、社交距離與行為——從行走、攀爬到分享、慶祝——研究兒童的特性。色彩心理學則把藍、綠、黃、橙、紫、白與平靜、成長、快樂、創造力等感受連結起來。
captions: 兒童特性——平均身高、社交距離、行為與色彩心理學。

sections.heading: Development
sections.body: The strategy divides the work into a pocket garden, with site renovation, fences, façades, cleaning, rolling space, play equipment, water play and healing plants, and a roof garden. The roof garden adds a drawing wall, outdoor classroom, children's farm, amphitheatre, meditation and sensory areas, an activity area and a parents' leisure area, each for its own ages.
captions: Strategy — eight interventions for the pocket garden and eight for the roof garden, with the ages each serves.
Planting strategy — trees, shrubs and herbs by flowering month, sensory value and native origin.

zh-Hant.heading: 推演
zh-Hant.body: 策略把工作分為口袋花園——場地改造、更新圍欄、立面改造、清理場地、起伏空間、遊具、戲水與療癒植物——以及屋頂花園。屋頂花園加入繪畫牆、戶外教室、兒童農場、圓形劇場、冥想區、感官區、活動區與家長休憩區，各自對應不同年齡。
captions: 策略——口袋花園與屋頂花園各八項介入，以及各自服務的年齡層。
植栽策略——依開花月份、感官價值與原生與否配置喬木、灌木與草本。

sections.heading: Outcome
sections.body: The master plan places 28 elements, from musical instruments and nest swings to a sensory pathway, a spiral garden and a physical therapy walkway. In the spiral garden children engage intimately with nature among lush flowers, and the low stone walls provide a sense of safety.
captions: Spiral flower bed design plan, façade effect and plant catalogue.
Circulation, function, planting and furnishings.
Section A-A' — sensory healing area, rolling meadow, wooden tunnel, climbing net, tree stump table and water pump.
Amphitheatre construction detail — the planted roof build-up over the existing building.

zh-Hant.heading: 成果
zh-Hant.body: 總平面配置了 28 項元素，從樂器、鳥巢鞦韆到感官步道、螺旋花園與物理治療步道。在螺旋花園裡，孩子在繁茂的花叢間親近自然，低矮的石牆則帶來安全感。
captions: 螺旋花床設計平面、立面效果與植物目錄。
動線、機能、植栽與設施。
A-A' 剖面——感官療癒區、起伏草地、木隧道、攀爬網、樹樁桌與水泵。
圓形劇場構造詳圖——既有建築上方的種植屋頂構造層。

sections.heading: How I Teach This Method
sections.body:
1. Design for the smallest user: measure children's height, distance and behaviour.
2. Listen to every group: children, families, staff and neighbours.
3. Use colour and planting as care: each feeling has a palette.
4. Detail the healing: from the master plan to the roof build-up.

zh-Hant.heading: 我如何教這套方法
zh-Hant.body:
1. 為最小的使用者設計：量測兒童的身高、距離與行為。
2. 傾聽每一個族群：兒童、家屬、醫護與鄰里。
3. 把色彩與植栽當作照護：每種感受都有它的色盤。
4. 把療癒做到細部：從總平面到屋頂構造。

pins.title: Living with Otters
pins.description:
Along Shenzhen Bay, a coast, an urban river and an internal lake are reshaped with holts, mangroves and safe passages so that otters can return to the city.

Shenzhen Bay, China | Biodiversity reservation | Mar 2022 | Student Project | Design Director: Yu Chun Tsai (full-cycle supervision)

zh-Hant.title: 與水獺共生
zh-Hant.description:
沿著深圳灣，以巢穴、紅樹林與安全通道改造海岸、城市河道與內湖，讓水獺得以回到城市。

中國深圳灣｜生物多樣性保育｜2022 年 3 月｜學生作品｜設計總監 Yu Chun Tsai，全程指導

captions: Aerial view of Shenzhen Bay: ecological, recreational, waterfront and educational areas along the otters' migration route.
深圳灣鳥瞰：沿水獺遷徙路線布置的生態景觀區、遊憩區、濱水區與教育區。

sections.heading: Problem
sections.body: Otters were once widely distributed in China, but their numbers have declined by 80–90 % in 40 years through hunting, habitat pollution, accidental death and the loss of habitat. An otter has been spotted at Shenzhen Bay since 2020, and seven remaining otters live in this area.
captions: Site context — Shenzhen Bay between the Futian Mangrove Nature Reserve, Mai Po and Hong Kong, with otter sightings from 2020 to 2024 and the predicted migration.
Site location and site analysis — climate, land use, flow accumulation, interference of human activity and biodiversity.

zh-Hant.heading: 問題
zh-Hant.body: 水獺曾廣泛分布於中國，但因獵捕、棲地污染、意外死亡與棲地喪失，數量在 40 年間減少了 80–90%。自 2020 年起，深圳灣有人目擊水獺，目前約有七隻水獺生活在這一帶。
captions: 基地脈絡——深圳灣，位於福田紅樹林自然保護區、米埔與香港之間，以及 2020–2024 年的水獺目擊點與預測遷徙路線。
基地位置與分析——氣候、土地使用、匯流、人為活動干擾與生物多樣性。

sections.heading: Research
sections.body: The life-cycle of otters sets the critical needs of the design: they are nocturnal, eat mostly fish, rest in holts and are highly adaptable from urban areas to the sea. Otters struggle to survive because of habitat destruction and human interference, from a lack of coherent corridors and food to water pollution, road accidents and pets.
captions: The critical needs for the life-cycle of otters — activity, home range, behaviours, diet and habitat.
From otters struggling to survive to an otter-friendly city — three locations, each with its own interventions.

zh-Hant.heading: 研究
zh-Hant.body: 水獺的生命週期決定了設計的關鍵需求：牠們夜行、以魚為主食、在巢穴中休息，從城市到海域都能高度適應。由於棲地破壞與人為干擾——從廊道不連續、食物減少，到水污染、道路意外與寵物——水獺艱難求生。
captions: 水獺生命週期的關鍵需求——活動、領域、行為、食性與棲地。
從水獺艱難求生到水獺友善城市——三個地點，各有各的介入。

sections.heading: Development
sections.body: Three design areas answer different needs: the coast improves habitat quality and increases the otter population, the urban river reduces emergency threats and expands habitable zones, and the internal lake stabilises the population and raises ecological awareness. Strategies include multi-void terrain remodelling, mangrove and seagrass planting, natural holts, roadkill prevention, a rescue station and interaction facilities.
captions: Plans of the three design areas — coast, urban river and internal lake.
Strategies for each location — terrain remodelling, planting, holts, migration assistance, a rescue station and an education base.

zh-Hant.heading: 推演
zh-Hant.body: 三個設計區對應不同需求：海岸提升棲地品質、增加水獺數量；城市河道減少緊急威脅、擴大可棲息範圍；內湖穩定族群並提升生態意識。策略包括多孔地形重塑、紅樹林與海草床種植、天然巢穴、防路殺措施、救援站與互動設施。
captions: 三個設計區的平面——海岸、城市河道與內湖。
各地點的策略——地形重塑、種植、巢穴、遷徙協助、救援站與教育基地。

sections.heading: Outcome
sections.body: On the coast a migration platform with an artificial reef and mangrove planting modules give otters abundant food and safe shelter, and along the urban river safe nests are easy to find. Artificial holts in green space and under the bridge are built from modular parts, and the handcrafted den model uses oyster shells and seashells mixed with biodegradable PLA for its 3D-printed supports.
captions: Location 1, coast — the migration platform and artificial reef, and the mangrove planting module; Location 2, urban river.
Holts in green space and under the bridge — materials and the six parts of the artificial holt.
Otter den handcrafted model, with interiors for a solitary otter, a mother with offspring and breeding otters.

zh-Hant.heading: 成果
zh-Hant.body: 在海岸，結合人工魚礁的遷徙平台與紅樹林種植模組，為水獺提供豐富的食物與安全的庇護；沿著城市河道，安全的巢穴容易找到。綠地中與橋下的人工巢穴以模組化構件組成；手工巢穴模型則以牡蠣殼、貝殼混合可降解 PLA 塑料，3D 列印出支撐結構。
captions: 地點一，海岸——遷徙平台與人工魚礁，以及紅樹林種植模組；地點二，城市河道。
綠地中與橋下的巢穴——人工巢穴的材料與六個構件。
水獺巢穴手工模型，以及獨居水獺、帶幼獺的母獺與繁殖期水獺的室內配置。

sections.heading: How I Teach This Method
sections.body:
1. Start from one animal's life-cycle: its needs become the brief.
2. Trace the threats before drawing: habitat loss and human interference.
3. Fit the strategy to each location: coast, river and lake differ.
4. Build the smallest home at full care: the den as a working model.

zh-Hant.heading: 我如何教這套方法
zh-Hant.body:
1. 從一種動物的生命週期出發：牠的需求就是任務書。
2. 下筆之前先追溯威脅：棲地喪失與人為干擾。
3. 讓策略因地制宜：海岸、河道與內湖各不相同。
4. 用心打造最小的家：把巢穴做成能運作的模型。

pins.title: Floating Forest
pins.description:
On Gao Di Street, one of Guangzhou's hottest old blocks, the plastic awnings over the lanes are replaced by planted canopies that shade and cool the street.

Gao Di Street, Guangzhou, China | Sustainable design | Sep 2024 | Student Project | Design Director: Yu Chun Tsai (full-cycle supervision)

zh-Hant.title: 漂浮森林
zh-Hant.description:
在廣州最炎熱的老街區之一高第街，巷道上方的塑膠雨棚被替換為種滿植物的天篷，為街道遮蔭降溫。

中國廣州高第街｜永續設計｜2024 年 9 月｜學生作品｜設計總監 Yu Chun Tsai，全程指導

captions: Master plan of Gao Di Street: green shades over the lanes, green roofs and the water system.
高第街總平面：巷道上方的「綠蔭」、綠屋頂與水系。

sections.heading: Problem
sections.body: In recent years the annual average temperature in China has risen significantly, and Guangzhou, a hot and humid city with high-intensity development, suffers a serious heat island effect. Gao Di Street in Yuexiu District is a heat island block with a strong heat load and weak heat dissipation, with plant coverage below 10 %, messy plastic awnings and a high rate of hardened ground.
captions: Background — high-temperature days in China, the average temperature from 1980 to 2023, and the heat island intensity of Guangzhou and Yuexiu District.
Site analysis — land use, plant coverage and sunshine radiation on a summer day.

zh-Hant.heading: 問題
zh-Hant.body: 近年來中國的年平均氣溫顯著上升；廣州氣候濕熱、開發強度高，熱島效應嚴重。越秀區的高第街是一個熱負荷強、散熱弱的熱島街區，植被覆蓋率不到 10%，塑膠雨棚雜亂，硬化地面比例很高。
captions: 背景——中國的高溫日數、1980–2023 年的平均氣溫，以及廣州與越秀區的熱島強度。
基地分析——土地使用、植被覆蓋與夏日的日照輻射強度。

sections.heading: Research
sections.body: Existing greening methods, large green spaces, roof gardens and vertical greening, and tall trees, are hard to achieve here because of land-use conflicts, legacy historical issues and the impact on infrastructure. In the past there was a natural environment, now plastic canopies are everywhere, and in the future they could turn into a floating forest.
captions: Inspiration, vision and strategy — neighbourhood comfort, environmental issues and community identity, towards a future forest floating above the city streets.
Selection of the pilot area — the historical water system, the main commercial street and the existing green space, with one-way, double-end and T-shaped lanes.

zh-Hant.heading: 研究
zh-Hant.body: 既有的綠化方式——大面積綠地、屋頂花園與垂直綠化、種植高大樹木——在此都因用地衝突、歷史遺留問題與對基礎設施的影響而難以實現。過去這裡是自然環境，如今塑膠雨棚無所不在；未來，它們或許能化為一片漂浮的森林。
captions: 靈感、願景與策略——鄰里舒適、環境問題與社區認同，邁向一片漂浮在城市街道上方的未來森林。
試點區的選擇——歷史水系、主要商業街與既有綠地，以及單向巷、雙出口巷與 T 形巷。

sections.heading: Development
sections.body: A conceptual model tested how green canopies could thread through the dense blocks. Typologies combine the canopies with water features, commercial streets and open space, each in four variations.
captions: Conceptual model — green canopies threading through the blocks.
Typology — T1 with water features, T2 with commercial streets, T3 with open space.

zh-Hant.heading: 推演
zh-Hant.body: 概念模型測試了綠色天篷如何穿行於密集的街區之間。類型學把天篷分別與水景、商業街與開放空間結合，各發展出四種變化。
captions: 概念模型——穿行於街區之間的綠色天篷。
類型學——T1 結合水景、T2 結合商業街、T3 結合開放空間。

sections.heading: Outcome
sections.body: Each canopy is built from vegetation on a geotextile substrate over a tensioned, anti-root waterproof fabric, held by masts, cables and anchor plates, and creates light therapy, shaded seating, an activity square, a dry spray fountain and a plant landscape. A physical model experiment grew Sedum morganianum on the fabric from September 2024 to January 2025.
captions: Key node design — structure, activity and function, vegetation list and construction details.
Plant growth — from the first roots on 30 September 2024 to lush cuttings on 1 January 2025.

zh-Hant.heading: 成果
zh-Hant.body: 每座天篷由種植在土工布基材上的植物、張拉式防根防水膜，以及桅桿、鋼索與錨板組成，創造出光療、遮蔭座椅、活動廣場、旱噴泉與植物景觀。實體模型實驗自 2024 年 9 月至 2025 年 1 月，在膜上培育了玉綴（Sedum morganianum）。
captions: 關鍵節點設計——結構、活動與機能、植物清單與構造詳圖。
植物生長——從 2024 年 9 月 30 日初生的根系，到 2025 年 1 月 1 日茂盛的插枝。

sections.heading: How I Teach This Method
sections.body:
1. Measure the heat before designing: maps make the problem visible.
2. Ask why the usual greening fails here, then design around it.
3. Turn what is already everywhere into the answer: awnings become canopies.
4. Grow it for real: a months-long planting test proves the idea.

zh-Hant.heading: 我如何教這套方法
zh-Hant.body:
1. 設計之前先量測熱：地圖讓問題現形。
2. 追問一般的綠化為何在此失效，再繞過它來設計。
3. 把隨處可見的東西變成答案：雨棚化為天篷。
4. 真的種出來：為期數月的種植實驗驗證概念。

pins.title: Doomsday Garden
pins.description:
Six survival modules for six imagined ends of the world, from extreme cold and heat to flood, drought, nuclear war and a siege of waste.

Anthropocene, Gaia | Concept project | Oct 2023 | Student Project | Design Director: Yu Chun Tsai (full-cycle supervision)

zh-Hant.title: 末日花園
zh-Hant.description:
為六種想像中的世界末日設計六個生存模組：從極寒與酷熱，到洪水、乾旱、核戰與垃圾圍城。

人類世，蓋亞｜概念設計｜2023 年 10 月｜學生作品｜設計總監 Yu Chun Tsai，全程指導

captions: Extreme cold: sealed, insulated survival modules linked by wooden walkways, with ice fishing and snow activities.
極寒：密封、高隔熱的生存模組以木棧道相連，並結合冰釣與雪上活動。

sections.heading: Problem
sections.body: The project asks what the world would become if it turned into an ocean or a desert, were covered in ice or enveloped in heat, or were destroyed by nuclear war or filled with garbage. Due to environmental degradation, urban structures have collapsed and human living spaces have rapidly condensed into two basic types.
captions: Before the disaster, the disaster occurs, after the disaster — mixture expanded functional spaces (commerce, farm, amuse, working, medical) and primary residential spaces.

zh-Hant.heading: 問題
zh-Hant.body: 本案提問：如果世界變成海洋或沙漠、被冰覆蓋或被高溫籠罩，又或是毀於核戰、被垃圾填滿，它將演變成什麼模樣。由於環境惡化，城市結構崩解，人類的生活空間迅速濃縮為兩種基本類型。
captions: 災前、災變、災後——混合擴展的機能空間（商業、農業、娛樂、工作、醫療）與基本居住空間。

sections.heading: Research
sections.body: Extreme climate and resource scarcity force the reorganisation of complex multifunctional spaces. Each scenario gets a survival module that combines the primary residential spaces with the functions life needs.

zh-Hant.heading: 研究
zh-Hant.body: 極端氣候與資源匱乏，迫使複雜的多機能空間重新組織。每一種情境都有一個生存模組，把基本居住空間與生活所需的機能結合起來。

sections.heading: Development
sections.body: In extreme heat the survival module is sunken, built with heat-resistant clay and surrounded by drought-tolerant plants, with shading devices and temperature regulation. In a flood it rests on floating platforms and elevated structures, with aquatic crops, boats and a closed-loop water system, and in a drought fog collection and purification devices sit at its core, enclosed by sea buckthorn and stones.
captions: Extreme hot — the sunken module with clay walls, shading and drought-tolerant planting.
Flooding — floating platforms, aquatic crops and boating.
Drought — fog collection at the core, drought-tolerant crops, sea buckthorn and stones.

zh-Hant.heading: 推演
zh-Hant.body: 在酷熱中，生存模組下沉，以耐熱黏土建造，四周種植耐旱植物，並配置遮陽裝置與溫度調節系統。在洪水中，它立於漂浮平台與架高結構之上，以水生作物、船隻與封閉的水循環系統維生；在乾旱中，集霧與淨水裝置位於核心，四周以沙棘與石塊圍合。
captions: 酷熱——黏土牆、遮陽與耐旱植栽的下沉模組。
洪水——漂浮平台、水生作物與以船代步。
乾旱——核心的集霧裝置、耐旱作物、沙棘與石塊。

sections.heading: Outcome
sections.body: After a nuclear war the module is compressed underground, with thick walls and radiation shielding, and its medical, sterilisation, agricultural and energy systems closely integrated. Under a waste siege it stands on an elevated platform of recycled materials, the medical area is kept apart from the living area, and waste is processed into organic fertiliser and renewable energy.
captions: Nuclear war — the underground module with radiation shielding.
Waste siege — the elevated platform of recycled materials, with separate medical areas.

zh-Hant.heading: 成果
zh-Hant.body: 核戰之後，模組被壓縮到地下，以厚牆與輻射屏蔽層保護居民，醫療、消毒、農業與能源系統緊密整合。在垃圾圍城的情境中，它立於以回收材料建造的架高平台上，醫療區與居住區分開，廢棄物則被處理為有機肥料與再生能源。
captions: 核戰——設有輻射屏蔽的地下模組。
垃圾圍城——以回收材料建造的架高平台，醫療區獨立設置。

sections.heading: How I Teach This Method
sections.body:
1. Ask “what if”: an extreme scenario reveals what a city really needs.
2. Reduce life to its functions: trade, farm, amuse, work, care.
3. Design one module per world and compare them side by side.
4. Draw with one language: a shared graphic system makes the set readable.

zh-Hant.heading: 我如何教這套方法
zh-Hant.body:
1. 提出「如果……會怎樣」：極端情境揭示城市真正的需求。
2. 把生活化約為機能：交易、農耕、娛樂、工作、照護。
3. 為每一個世界設計一個模組，並排比較。
4. 用同一種語言繪圖：共通的圖面系統讓整組作品易讀。

pins.title: Resilient Urban Design of Nansha
pins.description:
Under global warming and sea-level rise, a resilient coast, tidal parks and density prototypes let a new district in Nansha adapt as the water rises.

Nansha, Guangzhou | Urban design | Graduation design, group work (individual part) | Spring term 2023–2024 | Student Project | Design Director: Yu Chun Tsai (full-cycle supervision)

zh-Hant.title: 南沙韌性城市設計
zh-Hant.description:
在全球暖化與海平面上升的背景下，以韌性海岸、潮汐公園與密度原型，讓南沙的新城區隨水位上升而調適。

廣州南沙｜城市設計｜畢業設計，小組作品（個人部分）｜2023–2024 學年春季學期｜學生作品｜設計總監 Yu Chun Tsai，全程指導

captions: Aerial view render: the new district on the river delta, crossed by elevated roads and laced with green, wetland and water.
鳥瞰透視：河口三角洲上的新城區，高架道路穿越其間，綠地、濕地與水網交織。

sections.heading: Problem
sections.body: Under the dual environmental pressure of climate change and reclamation, Nansha must keep its coastal shorelines safe and cope with rainstorms, floods, typhoons, salty tides, storm surges, ocean currents and future sea-level rise. The board puts the rise at 98–188 mm by 2100, with US$1.4 trillion lost by 2100.
captions: The site in Nansha, with expressways, trunk roads, airports, harbours, train stations, the direction of tidal encroachment and typhoon attack, and the degree of sea-level-rise inundation.

zh-Hant.heading: 問題
zh-Hant.body: 在氣候變遷與填海造地的雙重環境壓力下，南沙必須確保海岸線安全，並因應暴雨、洪水、颱風、鹹潮、風暴潮、洋流以及未來的海平面上升。圖面指出，到 2100 年海平面將上升 98–188 毫米，損失達 1.4 兆美元。
captions: 位於南沙的基地，標示高速公路、主幹道、機場、港口、火車站、潮水侵入與颱風來襲方向，以及海平面上升的淹沒程度。

sections.heading: Research
sections.body: Sea-level rise superimposed on storm surges was mapped for 2030, 2050 and 2100, showing how much village and urban construction land, farmland, forest, wetland and river would be inundated. A section through industrial docks, petrochemical companies, logistics yards, the expressway, paddy fields, villages and mangrove forests sets these elements against the future water levels.
captions: Submerge Elements — the 2030, 2050 and 2100 scenarios and the section against the 2024 to 2100 water levels.
Storm surge disasters, swell channel, surface subsidence, the waterfowl ecological corridor and current land use.

zh-Hant.heading: 研究
zh-Hant.body: 本案繪製 2030、2050 與 2100 年海平面上升疊加風暴潮的情境，顯示村莊與城市建設用地、農地、林地、濕地與河流將被淹沒的比例。一道剖面穿過工業碼頭、石化企業、物流園區、高速公路、稻田、村莊與紅樹林，將這些要素與未來水位並置比較。
captions: 淹沒要素——2030、2050 與 2100 年情境，以及對照 2024 至 2100 年水位的剖面。
風暴潮災害、湧浪通道、地表沉降、水鳥生態廊道與現況土地使用。

sections.heading: Development
sections.body: Problems in agriculture, traffic, the river system and development control lead to a strategy of a resilient coast, a sustainable community, flexible transport and competitive industries around live, work and ecology. Along the sea coast, river shores and creek banks, prototypes such as offshore reefs, mangrove wetlands, green slopes, plank roads and water streets form a tidal park system.
captions: Problem consideration, structural prototypes and the four strategies.
Marine resilience and ecological protection — three steps from sea coast to river shores and creek banks.

zh-Hant.heading: 推演
zh-Hant.body: 從農業、交通、水系與開發管制的問題出發，本案圍繞生活、工作與生態，提出韌性海岸、永續社區、彈性交通與競爭力產業四項策略。沿著海岸、河岸與溪岸，離岸礁石、紅樹林濕地、綠坡、棧道與水街等原型共同組成潮汐公園系統。
captions: 問題思考、結構原型與四項策略。
海洋韌性與生態保護——從海岸、河岸到溪岸的三個步驟。

sections.heading: Outcome
sections.body: Residential, service, commercial and industrial units each have a FAR range and low-, medium- and high-density prototypes, which are then placed across the district under intensity guidelines. A timeline shows how land use changes as sea levels rise, from 2030 and 2050 to 2100 and beyond.
captions: Four prototypes of creative units, each in low, medium and high density.
Development intensity guidelines, dominated function units and overall intensity control.
Land use changes as sea levels rise: 2030, 2050, 2100 and the further future.

zh-Hant.heading: 成果
zh-Hant.body: 居住、服務、商業與工業單元各有容積率範圍，以及低、中、高密度的原型，再依開發強度準則配置於整個城區。一條時間軸呈現土地使用如何隨海平面上升而改變，從 2030、2050 年到 2100 年及更遠的未來。
captions: 四類創意單元原型，各有低、中、高密度版本。
開發強度準則、主導機能單元與整體強度管控。
土地使用隨海平面上升的變化：2030、2050、2100 年與更遠的未來。

sections.heading: How I Teach This Method
sections.body:
1. Start from the water: map sea-level rise and storm surge before drawing any plan.
2. Design by time: test the plan at 2030, 2050 and 2100.
3. Turn the shoreline into a system of prototypes.
4. Control intensity with simple units and clear rules.

zh-Hant.heading: 我如何教這套方法
zh-Hant.body:
1. 從水開始：在畫任何平面之前，先繪製海平面上升與風暴潮。
2. 以時間設計：在 2030、2050 與 2100 年檢驗方案。
3. 把海岸線轉化為一套原型系統。
4. 以簡單的單元與清楚的規則控制開發強度。

pins.title: Retrieving Folklore
pins.description:
Under the guidance of community co-construction, an elevated walkway and a chain of small public spaces turn Chaji village into a culture and business experience area.

Chaji Village, Foshan | Urban design | Urban Design 1, individual work | Spring term 2022–2023 | Student Project | Design Director: Yu Chun Tsai (full-cycle supervision)

zh-Hant.title: 重拾民俗
zh-Hant.description:
在社區共建的引導下，以一條高架步道與一連串小型公共空間，將茶基村轉化為文化與商業體驗區。

佛山茶基村｜城市設計｜城市設計一，個人作品｜2022–2023 學年春季學期｜學生作品｜設計總監 Yu Chun Tsai，全程指導

captions: Physical model: the village on both banks of the river, with a winding elevated walkway linking the middle school, the village and the commercial district.
實體模型：河道兩岸的村落，一條蜿蜒的高架步道串連中學、村落與商業區。

sections.heading: Problem
sections.body: Although Chaji village has experienced the modern gentrification of urbanization, local residents still stick to it, where the strong street smoke infuses everyone who passes by. The old street is also the base of the village's prosperity, so the transformation must balance the original residents, modern commercial activities and the conservation and dissemination of local traditional culture.
captions: Four paths through the village, thirteen cultural arches, and what a boy, a lady, an old lady and a girl said about the place.
Location and massing of the village and its river.

zh-Hant.heading: 問題
zh-Hant.body: 雖然茶基村經歷了城市化帶來的現代士紳化，在地居民仍堅守於此，濃厚的街頭煙火氣感染著每一位路過的人。老街也是村落繁榮的根基，因此改造必須在原住居民、現代商業活動，以及在地傳統文化的保存與傳播之間取得平衡。
captions: 穿越村落的四條路徑、十三處文化節點，以及一位男孩、一位女士、一位老婦人與一位女孩對這個地方的看法。
村落與河道的區位與量體。

sections.heading: Research
sections.body: Chaji village has a wealth of traditional folk activities, such as dragon boats, martial arts lions and Cantonese opera, and every Dragon Boat Festival people crowd the narrow lanes to watch the “floating dragon boat” make a rapid turn. The interviews list both the problems, such as narrow roads, local population loss and a lack of retail, and the strengths, such as a prosperous clan, a spacious riverside and rich folk activities.

zh-Hant.heading: 研究
zh-Hant.body: 茶基村擁有豐富的傳統民俗活動，例如龍舟、武術醒獅與粵劇；每年端午節，人們擠滿狹窄的巷弄，觀看「趴龍舟」急速轉彎。訪談同時列出問題，例如道路狹窄、本地人口流失與零售不足，也列出優勢，例如宗族興旺、河岸開闊與民俗活動豐富。

sections.heading: Development
sections.body: A combination of culture and business experience area under the guidance of community co-construction rests on people's participation, business vitality and cultural revival. Three steps prepare the canvas with small-scale greenery and DIY parks, sketch the traffic by adding lanes, replanning parking and removing cars, and work on textures by readapting existing structures and adding urban furniture.
captions: People's participation, business vitality and cultural revival, and Steps 1–3: environment, traffic and buildings.
Benign growth and organic renewal: the plan, with the commercial district, the tea plantation and four layers of services, access, greenery and community.

zh-Hant.heading: 推演
zh-Hant.body: 在社區共建引導下的文化與商業體驗區，以居民參與、商業活力與文化復興為基礎。三個步驟依序以小尺度綠化與 DIY 公園準備畫布，以增設步道、重新規劃停車與移除車輛梳理交通，再以改造既有建築與增設街道家具處理紋理。
captions: 居民參與、商業活力與文化復興，以及步驟一至三：環境、交通與建築。
良性生長與有機更新：總平面，含商業區、茶園，以及服務、可達性、綠地與社區四個層次。

sections.heading: Outcome
sections.body: A winding elevated walkway threads an intangible cultural heritage base, a dragon boat pavilion, a music hall, an outdoor stage, a lion dance club, a commercial street, a teahouse and homestays along the river. Green spots, a green corridor and a green district, widened streets, enriched outdoor space and revitalized blocks then open a chain of public spaces from a viewing plaza to a mobile market.
captions: Rendering explosion diagram of the programmes along the walkway.
Activities render: dragon boats, the walkway and daily life along the river.
Plane generation, dwelling renovation and the public open spaces.

zh-Hant.heading: 成果
zh-Hant.body: 一條蜿蜒的高架步道沿河串連非物質文化遺產基地、龍舟亭、音樂廳、戶外舞台、醒獅館、商業街、茶館與民宿。綠點、綠廊與綠區，加上拓寬的街道、豐富的戶外空間與活化的街區，開展出從觀景廣場到流動市集的一連串公共空間。
captions: 沿步道配置的各項機能之爆炸透視圖。
活動渲染圖：龍舟、步道與河岸的日常生活。
平面生成、民居改造與公共開放空間。

sections.heading: How I Teach This Method
sections.body:
1. Listen first: let residents of every age tell you what the place lacks and what it has.
2. Read culture as space: festivals need lanes, riverbanks and stages.
3. Renew in small steps: greenery, traffic, then buildings.
4. Thread the programmes on one route.

zh-Hant.heading: 我如何教這套方法
zh-Hant.body:
1. 先傾聽：讓各個年齡的居民說出這個地方缺少什麼、擁有什麼。
2. 把文化讀成空間：節慶需要巷弄、河岸與舞台。
3. 以小步驟更新：先綠化，再交通，最後建築。
4. 用一條路徑串起所有機能。

pins.title: Hongkong {female} ∈ London
pins.description:
Anti-homogeneity urban design based on the female perspective: a female-friendly autonomous community in London for women who have moved from Hong Kong.

London, UK | Urban design | Comprehensive Social Investigation, individual work | Spring term 2021–2022 | Student Project | Design Director: Yu Chun Tsai (full-cycle supervision)

zh-Hant.title: 香港 {女性} ∈ 倫敦
zh-Hant.description:
基於女性視角的反同質化城市設計：在倫敦為從香港移居的女性打造一個對女性友善的自治社區。

英國倫敦｜城市設計｜綜合社會調查，個人作品｜2021–2022 學年春季學期｜學生作品｜設計總監 Yu Chun Tsai，全程指導

captions: A-A'-1 section: residential towers opened up floor by floor beside the office buildings.
A-A'-1 剖面：逐層剖開的住宅大樓，與一旁的辦公建築並列。

sections.heading: Problem
sections.body: With high-density development in the process of urbanization, Southeast Asian women in traditional society are facing more severe injustices, which coincides with the upsurge of Hong Kong immigrants to Britain. The project hopes to build a female-friendly regional autonomous community in London by thinking from the perspective of women.
captions: The site on the Thames, with 2.5 km and 5 km radii, residential, industrial and commercial zones, greenland and transportation.

zh-Hant.heading: 問題
zh-Hant.body: 在城市化進程中的高密度開發下，傳統社會中的東南亞女性正面臨更嚴重的不公，這恰逢香港移民赴英的熱潮。本案希望從女性的視角思考，在倫敦打造一個對女性友善的區域自治社區。
captions: 泰晤士河畔的基地，標示 2.5 公里與 5 公里半徑，以及住宅、工業與商業區、綠地與交通。

sections.heading: Research
sections.body: The background maps the distribution of immigrants to the UK and British immigration sources, then the gender and age proportion of BN(O) arrivals, their self-assessed English level and their interest in social and cultural activities. It also records the sectors in which BN(O)s are working and aspects of their health and wellbeing.
captions: Background: distribution and sources of immigrants, gender and age, English level, activities, work sectors and wellbeing.
User analysis: a pregnant woman, an elderly woman, a new mother, a female vendor, a toddler mother and an office lady.

zh-Hant.heading: 研究
zh-Hant.body: 背景研究繪製移民在英國的分布與移民來源，再分析 BN(O) 移民的性別與年齡比例、自評英語程度，以及對社交與文化活動的興趣。研究也記錄了 BN(O) 移民從事的行業，以及他們健康與福祉的各個面向。
captions: 背景：移民的分布與來源、性別與年齡、英語程度、活動、從業行業與福祉。
使用者分析：孕婦、年長女性、新手媽媽、女性攤販、幼兒母親與上班族女性。

sections.heading: Development
sections.body: Each user gets a design response: emergency call buttons on street lamps at 15 m intervals for pregnant women, shaded, wheelchair-accessible seating for older women, and more space in public bathrooms for mothers and babies. A street-level space lets female vendors work apart from the road, and enclosed, separate office cubicles ensure privacy and equity at work, while the concept plan arranges commercial, office and residential bands around Olympia House.
captions: Concept design plan and the abstract spatial structure of commercial, office and residential bands.

zh-Hant.heading: 推演
zh-Hant.body: 每一類使用者都有對應的設計：為孕婦在路燈上每隔 15 公尺設置緊急呼叫按鈕，為年長女性設置有遮蔭、可供輪椅使用的座位，並在公共廁所為母親與嬰兒預留更多空間。街道層的空間讓女性攤販能遠離車道工作，獨立封閉的辦公隔間則確保工作上的隱私與平等；概念平面以奧林匹亞大樓為中心，配置商業、辦公與住宅帶。
captions: 概念設計平面，以及商業、辦公與住宅帶的抽象空間結構。

sections.heading: Outcome
sections.body: The master plan lays courtyard blocks along the river with sections A-A'-1 and A-A'-2 and three viewpoints for residence, office and commerce. The sections show the community from its opened-up towers to a festive waterfront with a ferry and fireworks.
captions: Master plan with sections A-A'-1 and A-A'-2 and viewpoints 1–3.
Activities render — viewpoint 1 residence, viewpoint 2 office, viewpoint 3 commercial.
A-A'-2 section: the waterfront at night.

zh-Hant.heading: 成果
zh-Hant.body: 總平面沿河配置合院式街廓，並標示 A-A'-1 與 A-A'-2 剖面，以及住宅、辦公與商業三個視點。剖面呈現這個社區的樣貌：從逐層剖開的大樓，到有渡輪與煙火的節慶水岸。
captions: 總平面，標示 A-A'-1、A-A'-2 剖面與視點一至三。
活動渲染圖——視點一住宅、視點二辦公、視點三商業。
A-A'-2 剖面：夜間的水岸。

sections.heading: How I Teach This Method
sections.body:
1. Design from a perspective: name whose city you are designing.
2. Use data to find the users, then draw them.
3. Give every user one concrete spatial answer.
4. Tell the story in sections people can read.

zh-Hant.heading: 我如何教這套方法
zh-Hant.body:
1. 從一個視角設計：說清楚你在為誰設計城市。
2. 用數據找出使用者，再把他們畫出來。
3. 為每一位使用者給出一個具體的空間回應。
4. 用人人看得懂的剖面說故事。

pins.title: URU Fairy Land
pins.description:
Fluid urbanism design based on human-body sensation: body parts are flattened into lines and rebuilt by a formula into the forms of a mobile city.

Urban design | Spring term 2019–2020 | Student Project | Design Director: Yu Chun Tsai (full-cycle supervision)

zh-Hant.title: URU 仙境
zh-Hant.description:
基於人體感知的流動都市主義設計：將身體部位壓平為線條，再以公式重建為流動城市的形態。

城市設計｜2019–2020 學年春季學期｜學生作品｜設計總監 Yu Chun Tsai，全程指導

captions: Overall form: the combined body-part models joined into one fluid volume.
整體形態：由各身體部位模型組合成的流動量體。

sections.heading: Problem
sections.body: The city is “mobile” in the sense that people's five senses are shifted by the activities and the rich religious beliefs of the student's hometown, and the impression of the city changes with them. Using the body as a starting point, the project explores the possibility of a mobile city through the spatial translation of body parts.

zh-Hant.heading: 問題
zh-Hant.body: 城市是「流動的」：人的五感會隨著家鄉的各種活動與豐富的宗教信仰而轉移，對城市的印象也隨之改變。本案以身體為起點，透過身體部位的空間轉譯，探索流動城市的可能。

sections.heading: Research
sections.body: Step 1, Flatten, takes the brain, eye, mouth, neck, vessels, torso, hands, skin and bone one by one. Each part is drawn as four line studies that extract its form.
captions: Form extraction: four line studies for each of nine body parts.

zh-Hant.heading: 研究
zh-Hant.body: 第一步「壓平」，依序處理大腦、眼睛、嘴巴、頸部、血管、軀幹、雙手、皮膚與骨骼。每個部位都以四張線稿萃取出它的形態。
captions: 形態萃取：九個身體部位，各四張線稿。

sections.heading: Development
sections.body: Since the senses work synergistically with each other, a few elements from the different form-extraction studies that match the imagery are combined. The formula (A + B) × C multiplies two forms by a motion, and each combination generates a 3D model.
captions: Formula: (A + B) × C, form times motion.
Rebuild, first row: three combinations and their 3D models.
Rebuild, second row.
Rebuild, third row.

zh-Hant.heading: 推演
zh-Hant.body: 由於感官彼此協同運作，本案從不同的形態萃取中挑選符合意象的元素加以組合。公式 (A + B) × C 以兩種形態乘上一種運動，每一組組合都生成一個 3D 模型。
captions: 公式：(A + B) × C，形態乘以運動。
重建第一列：三組組合及其 3D 模型。
重建第二列。
重建第三列。

sections.heading: Outcome
sections.body: The models are mapped back onto the body as the foot sole, intestinal tract, skin, joint, blood vessel, arms, eyes and cervical spine, each with an action such as winding, smooth, plastic, interspersed, distort, extend and reverse. Together they form the overall form of the fluid city.

zh-Hant.heading: 成果
zh-Hant.body: 這些模型再對應回身體，成為腳掌、腸道、皮膚、關節、血管、手臂、眼睛與頸椎，各自帶有纏繞、平滑、可塑、穿插、扭曲、延伸與反轉等動作。它們共同組成流動城市的整體形態。

sections.heading: How I Teach This Method
sections.body:
1. Start from your own body and senses.
2. Flatten before you build: draw each part as lines.
3. Write a rule, such as form plus form times motion.
4. Let the rule generate many models, then choose.

zh-Hant.heading: 我如何教這套方法
zh-Hant.body:
1. 從自己的身體與感官出發。
2. 先壓平再建構：把每個部位畫成線條。
3. 寫下一條規則，例如形態加形態乘以運動。
4. 讓規則生成許多模型，再從中挑選。

pins.title: Under the Midnight Sun
pins.description:
A theater in front of the Taipei Fine Arts Museum lets visitors walk through Keigo Higashino's “White Night Journey” chapter by chapter, led by a detective or on their own.

Taipei Fine Arts Museum, Taipei | Theater design | Student Project | Design Director: Yu Chun Tsai (full-cycle supervision)

zh-Hant.title: 白夜行
zh-Hant.description:
在臺北市立美術館前的劇場，讓參觀者逐章走進東野圭吾的《白夜行》，跟隨偵探，或自行探索。

臺北市立美術館，臺北｜劇場設計｜學生作品｜設計總監 Yu Chun Tsai，全程指導

captions: Hand-made model: stacked timber frames and coloured planes, explored by hand to find the form of the space.
手作模型：堆疊的木框架與彩色板片，以手作探索空間的形態。

sections.heading: Problem
sections.body: Keigo Higashino's mystery novel “White Night Journey” cleverly reveals the connection between its two characters, and its film adaptation raised the question of whether the charm of words can be conveyed through spatial design. Immersing oneself in a book involves recreating crime scenes and embodying the text in a designed space.
captions: The site: an empty space in front of the Taipei Fine Arts Museum, where designers are invited to create new works every year.
Put a book in the real world: from book to movie, and from places to stories.

zh-Hant.heading: 問題
zh-Hant.body: 東野圭吾的推理小說《白夜行》巧妙地揭示兩位主角之間的關聯；它被改編成電影，引出一個問題：文字的魅力能否透過空間設計傳達。沉浸在一本書中，意味著重現犯罪現場，並把文字具體化為一個被設計的空間。
captions: 基地：臺北市立美術館前的空地，每年邀請設計師在此創作。
把書放進真實世界：從書到電影，從場所到故事。

sections.heading: Research
sections.body: The plot is mapped across five chapters, from a dark childhood, high school life and a dirty commercial to university life and death, together with the scenes where the characters are. Traversing the space then lets visitors understand the book's narrative and activates their perceptual systems for a unique entertainment experience.
captions: Different scenes where the characters are, chapter by chapter.

zh-Hant.heading: 研究
zh-Hant.body: 本案把情節拆解為五個章節，從黑暗的童年、高中生活、骯髒的交易，到大學生活與死亡，並標示角色所在的各個場景。穿越空間，讓參觀者理解書中的敘事，也喚醒他們的感知系統，帶來獨特的娛樂體驗。
captions: 角色所在的不同場景，逐章呈現。

sections.heading: Development
sections.body: Hand-made models explore a space that integrates play, performance and leisure, a fantasy city about walking on white nights. Five coloured blocks for the five chapters are raised, scattered, connected by a main channel and cut into pentagons, in pink, red and white taken from Xuesui's cloth.
captions: Model studies of the frame-and-plane space.
Bulk formation: raise, scatter, connect, reshape into a pentagon and cut.

zh-Hant.heading: 推演
zh-Hant.body: 以手作模型探索一個融合遊戲、表演與休閒的空間，一座關於在白夜中行走的幻想城市。代表五個章節的五個彩色量體被抬升、打散，以主要通道相連，再切割成五角形；粉紅、紅與白三色取自雪穗的衣料。
captions: 框架與板片空間的模型研究。
量體生成：抬升、打散、串連、改為五角形，再切割。

sections.heading: Outcome
sections.body: Five chapters become five areas, and each small space is about one story. Visitors first meet a detective who leads them to the first scene, and then either follow the detective's way through the building or explore the plot freely, guided by two colours of stairs.
captions: Spatial streamline and composition: five chapters to five areas, the detective way and the free way.
Section display, with stair and C-stud partition details.

zh-Hant.heading: 成果
zh-Hant.body: 五個章節化為五個區域，每一個小空間都關於一段故事。參觀者先遇見一位偵探，由他帶到第一個場景；之後可以跟隨偵探的路線走完整棟建築，也可以自由探索情節，兩種顏色的樓梯為他們引路。
captions: 空間動線與構成：五個章節化為五個區域，偵探路線與自由路線。
剖面展示，附樓梯與 C 型鋼隔間細部。

sections.heading: How I Teach This Method
sections.body:
1. Read a story as a plan: chapters, scenes and paths.
2. Build by hand first: a model finds the form faster than a screen.
3. Let colour carry meaning.
4. Give visitors a guide and a choice.

zh-Hant.heading: 我如何教這套方法
zh-Hant.body:
1. 把故事讀成平面：章節、場景與路徑。
2. 先動手做：模型比螢幕更快找到形態。
3. 讓色彩承載意義。
4. 給參觀者一位嚮導，也給他們選擇。
